shortDescription: HDFC Bank's Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha has quit, the country's largest private sector lender announced on Saturday.Bharucha, who has been with the bank since 1995, "requested cessation" from service from December 31, the bank informed exchanges.

title: HDFC Bank Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha quits ahead of Anup Bagchi’s takeover
